entry.title: Zero-Shot Multimodal Event Spotting in Soccer Broadcasts
entry.summary: Automatic soccer event spotting supports highlight generation, video indexing, and sports analytics, but existing methods depend on large annotated datasets and soccer-specific training. entry.title: FL4N: Feed-forward Latent Model for 4D Novel View Synthesis
entry.summary: 4D novel view synthesis (NVS) aims to render dynamic scenes across viewpoints and timestamps, which requires jointly inferring 3D structure and temporal dynamics. Existing monocular feed-forward methods often rely on explicit 4D Gaussian representations, which are prone to temporal inconsistency and severe rendering artifacts.
